answer: Agents trading opal face cheap fake sellers. An admission auction stops this: 50 slots open per epoch, won by bidding a deposit. Each bidder locks 200 POA; the top 50 win, deposits locked 20 epochs. A caught faker loses deposit and slot; a rented slot slashes lender and borrower alike. Forging 100 fake stalls selling vine cuttings costs 20,000 POA; one honest seller of anchors pays 200 POA, keeps every sale, gets the deposit back.
